title: system Admin
description:
Job role: System Admin

Location: Des Moines, Iowa - (Onsite)

Contract

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • · Install, configure, and manage Windows and Linux servers (physical & virtual) Perform system builds, patching, upgrades, vulnerability management, and lifecycle management Manage Active Directory / LDAP and implement identity & access controls Monitor server performance, availability, and capacity metrics
  • · Manage, monitor, and troubleshoot VMware environments (ESXi hosts, clusters, VMs) Perform VM provisioning, cloning, and migrations (vMotion, Storage vMotion) Manage VMware clusters (HA, DRS, resource pools) Monitor and optimize virtualization performance and availability
  • · Support and maintain enterprise storage platforms (SAN/NAS/Object storage, e.g., PowerFlex) Perform LUN provisioning, zoning, masking, and volume management Manage storage capacity, upgrades, replication, snapshots, and performance tuning Identify and resolve storage space constraints and performance issues
  • · Configure and manage enterprise backup solutions (Dell PowerProtect preferred) Implement secure and air-gapped backup strategies Perform backup monitoring, restore validation, and compliance checks Execute VM/file-level restores, DR testing, failover, and failback operations Maintain disaster recovery strategies and resiliency planning
  • · Administer servers, workstations, and network-connected systems Support endpoint and security tools (Defender, CrowdStrike) Implement RBAC, security controls, encryption, and compliance requirements
  • · Support enterprise applications (RightFax, Kofax, OpenText) Assist with platform upgrades, integrations, and performance tuning Collaborate with application teams for system stability and availability
  • · Support data center operations including migrations, decommissioning, and relocations Assist in EOL transitions, rack decommissioning, and secure system movement Participate in migration planning and execution activities
  • · Monitor infrastructure health across compute, storage, virtualization, and applications Troubleshoot multi-layer issues (VMware, storage latency, connectivity, application failures) Provide L2/L3 support, incident resolution, and root cause analysis
  • · Perform patching, upgrades, performance tuning, and lifecycle management Maintain infrastructure documentation, SOPs, and runbooks Handle capacity planning and forecasting
  • · Support ITSM processes (incident, problem, change, release management) Ensure CMDB is updated and aligned with infrastructure and cloud environments
  • · Develop automation scripts (PowerShell, Bash, Python) Improve provisioning efficiency and integrate tools using APIs
  • · Collaborate with infrastructure, security, cloud, and service delivery teams Ensure system availability, performance, and service continuity

Skills & Qualifications

  • · Strong VMware administration experience (ESXi, vCenter, clusters, HA, DRS) Hands-on experience with enterprise storage systems (PowerFlex, EMC, NetApp, etc.) Strong knowledge of SAN/NAS, RAID, iSCSI, Fibre Channel
  • · Experience with enterprise backup platforms (Dell PowerProtect preferred) Knowledge of backup compliance, air-gapped backups, and disaster recovery testing
  • · Proficiency in Windows and Linux server administration Experience managing Active Directory / LDAP and access controls
  • · Experience with endpoint/security tools (Defender, CrowdStrike) Strong understanding of infrastructure security and compliance practices
  • · Ability to support enterprise applications (RightFax, Kofax, OpenText) Experience with application integrations and platform support
  • · Strong troubleshooting skills across compute, virtualization, storage, and applications Ability to perform root cause analysis and documentation
  • · Experience with ITSM tools/processes (incident, change, problem management) Familiarity with monitoring and infrastructure management tools
  • · Scripting and automation experience (PowerShell, Bash, Python, REST APIs) Exposure to cloud and hybrid environments (AWS/Azure is a plus)
  • · Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills

title: Cloud Infrastructure Idty Mngmt
description:
Merz Therapeutics is modernizing its global IT landscape to enable secure, seamless, and compliant digital collaboration. As a key member of the Corporate Software Services IT organization, the Manager, Cloud Infrastructure & Identity Management plays a central role in driving Microsoft 365–centric projects that modernize the digital workplace at global scale.
This role combines hands-on engineering expertise with strong project leadership, supporting enterprise initiatives such as Microsoft 365 platform modernization, Copilot adoption, Zero Trust security, and cloud-first transformation.

Key Responsibilities
Microsoft 365 Platform & Project Leadership (Primary Focus)

Lead the architecture, engineering, and continuous improvement of Microsoft 365 services, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive.
Drive global Microsoft 365 projects from initiation through delivery, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant outcomes.
Own end-to-end project lifecycles, including planning, execution, stakeholder coordination, and successful delivery across regions.
Lead optimization initiatives across the Microsoft 365 collaboration suite to improve performance, reliability, and user adoption at enterprise scale.
Support the integration of third-party applications and automation initiatives within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

Copilot & Digital Workplace Innovation

Contribute to Copilot readiness and adoption initiatives, ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and identity governance requirements.
Partner with security, infrastructure, and endpoint teams to enable AI-assisted productivity within the Microsoft 365 platform.
Support continuous improvement of digital workplace capabilities through automation, standardization, and governance.

Microsoft Teams, SharePoint & Power Platform

Lead and support Microsoft Teams and SharePoint Online services as core collaboration platforms.
Enable and govern Power Platform integrations and solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
Develop technical documentation, standards, governance models, and best practices for collaboration and low-code platforms.

Security, Identity & Compliance

Implement and maintain security and compliance configurations, including identity governance, data protection, and Zero Trust principles.
Collaborate closely with security and endpoint teams on integrated identity and access solutions.

Operations, Support & Team Leadership

Provide Tier 3 engineering support for complex Microsoft 365, identity, and cloud-related incidents.
Lead and motivate small, distributed project teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and delivery excellence.
Coordinate cross-functional and international teams to ensure alignment with business and IT objectives.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a hands-on Microsoft 365 engineer and project leader with a strong foundation in identity, security, and enterprise collaboration platforms. You thrive in a global environment and enjoy combining platform ownership, project execution, and digital workplace innovation, including Copilot and automation capabilities.

Work Experience
Required Experience

Strong experience in Microsoft 365 engineering, cloud security, and enterprise IT infrastructure
Proven ability to lead and deliver global Microsoft 365–focused projects
Solid background in operational support, platform optimization, security, and compliance controls
Years of Experience

We expect 5-10 years of Microsoft 365 Services experience.

Required Skills

Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive)
Entra ID / identity and endpoint integration
Zero Trust concepts and cloud security best practices
Exposure to Copilot, automation, or AI-enabled productivity within Microsoft 365
Incident management and structured problem-solving
Documentation, standards, and governance development
Strong project management skills (Agile, Hybrid, or Waterfall)

title: Product Surveillance Associate
description:
The Product Surveillance Specialist V performs day-to-day tasks and provides technical data assessment of post-market events and can support the Quality Department with Quality System activities including Change Control and Client/CAPA. This position plays an integral role in maintaining compliance with global regulations. The Product Surveillance Specialist V works with minimal supervision and requires a high degree of interaction with customers, health care professionals, global government agencies, and Global Merz employees at all levels within the organization.

Work Environment:
Onsite Required
Overtime limited
Must be able to pass vision testing requirements at 20/20 near acuity vision (with or without corrective eyewear).

Key Responsibilities:
• Independently field inquiries received by phone, electronic or verbal correspondence and determine if it qualifies as a complaint; document reported issues according to applicable SOP(s).
• Provide technical support and remote troubleshooting guidance as needed.
• Independently review associated records, and contact users and customers to collect information on the treatment, product performance, functionality, etc.
• Conduct periodic follow-up to close complaints in a timely manner.
• Manage customer relationship and expectations during the course of the complaint investigation.
• Independently complete investigations, which may include execution or coordination of product returns and subsequent evaluations, review of manufacturing records and ensuring proper approvals are obtained as part of closure.
• Develop solutions to a variety of moderate problems.
• Conduct statistical analysis of complaint trends.
• Support training program by training users on the complaint process and tools used to assess and investigate complaints.

Process Improvement Initiatives:
• Supports and may identify operational changes to improve efficiencies in all aspects of complaint handling.
• Support and sometimes lead investigations associated with product deviations, product non-conformances, CAPAs, scrap and rework, and analyzing the data for the reasons of Quality Improvement and reporting.
• Update internal operating procedures and specifications through the Document Change process.

Compliance Initiatives:
• Support and participate in internal quality system audits. Support external quality system audits.
• Evaluate complaints and determine if the submission of a Medical Device Report (MDR) or other Vigilance Report is required.
• Support submitting MDRs and Vigilance Reports according to regulatory timelines.

Education (required):
High School Diploma with 4 years of experience OR Associate's Degree with 2 years of experience OR Bachelor's Degree

Work Experience:
Medical or Surgical Office Experience (preferred)
Customer Service Experience (preferred)

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
• Familiar with ISO 13485 Quality System Standards, FDA Quality System Regulations, GMPs, and/or other international medical device regulations.
• Basic medical and/or scientific terminology.
• Highly organized with attention to detail.
• Strong ability to prioritize and manage multiple records/reports simultaneously.
• Professional phone etiquette with the ability to appropriately handle sensitive information.
• Effective communication skills including written and verbal.
• Ability to work with company staff and communicate effectively throughout the organization.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

title: Product Manager
description:
Job Title: Product Manager

Location: South San Francisco

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with deep expertise in the pharmaceutical commercial space to strategically drive and support upcoming product launches for one of our pharma clients.

Location: Hybrid (3 days a week at South San Francisco office)

Position Overview:

We are currently seeking a strong Product Manager to help us build and launch the brand performance tracker for the upcoming client launch. We are looking for an outcome-driven approach structured around clear deliverables, SLAs, and measures of success. Rather than a standard metrics-mapping exercise, we need rigorous product management support through the MVP launch.

Key Requirements and Success Criteria:

• Scalable Design & Setup: The Brand view must be scalable to accommodate future launches and Tier 1/2 brands (e.g., future models may be hybrid SP/no-SP, need/not need REMS, hubs, etc.).

• Intuitive User Journey & Harmonization: The tool needs logical, intuitive drilldowns from the National level down to the Segment/Ecosystem, Target List, HCO, and HCP levels. At the most granular levels, this must harmonize with existing Figma designs from other workstreams.

• Strategic Thought Partnership: When interfacing with TA I&A and FAI, we expect thought partnership on metrics, business rules, and data visualization. We are looking for a partner to help systemically up level the product, rather than just consuming provided inputs.

• Technical Rigor & Documentation: The PM must interface seamlessly with data teams. This requires writing detailed requirements and comprehensive documentation, assessing capabilities, and conducting testing and analysis on the data and metrics.

• Cross-Functional Process Management: The PM will need to efficiently link existing product readiness, manage the overall cross-functional process (both input and output perspectives), and provide daily/weekly updates to our core team.

We are looking for a presentation from a candidate who can walk us through a tailored product management process specifically for the asked brand launch tracker, rather than a generic 101-level outline.

title: BI Developer
description:
CCC Reporting & Dashboard Development

SCOPE OF WORK

THE CITY COLLEGES OF CHICAGO

https://ccc.edu

5/22/2026

OVERVIEW

City Colleges of Chicago (CCC) is seeking an experienced BI Developer to support the development of interactive dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions that provide centralized access to key institutional metrics. These solutions will support data-informed decision making, operational planning, and student success initiatives in alignment with institutional priorities, including 55 for All. The consultant will support multiple reporting and analytics initiatives across departments by developing scalable, user-friendly reporting solutions and improving access to institutional data. The ideal consultant will have expertise in Tableau dashboard development, data visualization, and reporting tools, along with experience translating business and operational needs into technical solutions. CCC's Decision Support and Business Intelligence teams will provide the necessary data access, licenses, and institutional support. The consultant may work on multiple reporting projects, dashboards, and analytical initiatives that support institutional health, operational effectiveness, strategic planning, and continuous improvement efforts across the organization.

SCOPE OF WORK

The selected consultant will be responsible for:

Dashboard Design and Development

· Designing, developing, and maintaining interactive dashboards, reports, and visual analytics solutions for institutional and operational reporting needs

· Creating standardized and reusable dashboard templates and reporting frameworks that can support multiple initiatives and departments

· Developing intuitive navigation, filtering, and self-service functionality for end users

· Supporting reporting initiatives related to institutional effectiveness, student success, compliance, operations, and strategic planning

· Applying data visualization best practices and accessibility standards across reporting solutions

Data Integration and Automation

· Connecting dashboards and reports to institutional data systems and data sources for scheduled or real-time updates

· Supporting automated data refresh processes, validation procedures, and quality assurance activities

· Collaborating with internal teams to establish appropriate data governance, security, and reporting standards

· Assisting with integration of reporting tools with databases, APIs, SharePoint lists, and other enterprise systems

Content Organization

· Collaborating with stakeholders to standardize metric definitions, calculations, and reporting methodologies

· Ensuring consistency in reporting structures, dashboard layouts, and visualization practices across projects

· Supporting documentation of reporting processes, governance standards, and technical workflows

Testing and Continuous Improvement

· Conducting usability testing and gathering stakeholder feedback to improve reporting solutions

· Developing sustainable maintenance and support processes for long-term reporting initiatives

User Training and Documentation

· Creating Developing training materials and guides for end users and administrators

Timeline

Proposals should include a clear timeline, but we aim to begin this work in mid-July 2026 and end in late-August with the possibility of extending based on institutional needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Technical Expertise

· Expert proficiency in Tableau Desktop, Prep and Cloud with demonstrated experience creating interactive dashboards, is required

· Experience in dashboard development, including interactive features and automated data pipelines

· Strong knowledge of higher education data structures and common metrics

· Ability to integrate Tableau with institutional data systems and databases, including PeopleSoft CS9, SharePoint, OpenBook, and application programming interfaces (APIs).

· Strong background in data visualization best practices and accessibility standards

· Proficiency in SQL, ETL processes, and relevant programming languages

Collaboration & Communication Skills

· Ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders across multiple departments

· Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate user needs into technical solutions

· Experience creating clear documentation and training materials

· Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Experience & Certifications

· Tableau dashboard development experience in a higher education environment

· Previous work with community college data systems and metrics

· Tableau certifications such as:

o Tableau Desktop Certified Professional

o Tableau Server Certified Professional

o Tableau Data Management Certified
